properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main): the unmotivated_capability gap's evidence prints `provenance=authored` for every Capability whose provenance is not `inferred`. The detector reduces provenance to one boolean and prints the boolean's label under the stored field's name, so imported, planned, healed and reconciled all read as authored
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, entry of 2026-10-01 "public-only bounded member adoption".

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words (0.76.0): "the shared export stores Capability `provenance: imported`, with a public Fragment YIELDED link. `detect_gaps` nevertheless describes that capability with `(provenance=authored)`. No acceptance or authored promotion was made." NOT affected: the stored value and the export, which both say imported.

② PRECEDENT: searched ("provenance=authored", "imported capability detect_gaps evidence"). No recorded cause. dec:idea-does-unmotivated-severity-key-on-built-not-provenance (open, 2026-08-11) counted 16 `imported` capabilities on reflow2's own design all reading the same way, and did not notice the label.

③ CANDIDATES:
(a) the import or a later write re-stamped provenance to authored;
(b) detect_gaps reads a different property than the one stored;
(c) the evidence string renders a derived value, not the stored one;
(d) the observation is wrong: the reporter read a different capability.

⑤ MEASURED, `--call` on scratch stores, the same steps on each binary. One requirement, one capability with no SATISFIES, then set_provenance to imported.
- get_node: `provenance: imported` on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main. This refutes (a).
- detect_gaps, all three: `Capability 'cap:imp' (provenance=authored) has 0 outgoing SATISFIES`, severity 0.55.
- On main, the provenance set to planned, healed and reconciled: all three read `provenance=authored`, at 0.55. Set to inferred: `provenance=inferred`, at 0.70.
This separates (c) from (b): the property is read correctly (inferred moves the severity), and only its rendering is wrong. (d) is refuted by the reproduction.

CODE, main f46bd3065: crates/reflow2-core/src/detect.rs, the unmotivated_capability detector, about line 3088 and line 3114. `let inferred = provenance == Some("inferred")`, then the evidence prints `provenance={}` with `if inferred { "inferred" } else { "authored" }`. Written in cf4721245 (2026-07-18, BL-27), when the split was the point. The description and severity also treat every non-inferred value as authored, which is that open decision's question, not this defect.

⑥ CLASS: evidence prose names a derived value as if it were the stored field. The same shape (`if x { "a" } else { "b" }` rendered as a field value) appears nowhere else in reflow2-core/src. One other site renders a boolean as a word, "exactly"/"nearly" in detect.rs about line 3345, but it does not claim to be a stored field.

⑦ NOT DONE (triage only): the pinning test. It would iterate every Capability.provenance enum value and assert the evidence names the stored value.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the reporter's capability also lacked SATISFIES for a reason the gap should say (an imported capability from a public fragment may legitimately have no requirement in this design).
